field_principles.duration_s: Elapsed research time makes an implausibly short source claim visible.

field_principles.gate_check_summary: The gate summary names exact expected and observed values when preflight blocks.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal complete_ prefix lets the conductor classify the outcome without guessing.
field_principles.implementation_rows: Implementation rows map source methods to exact V606 experiments and boundaries.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate states that this task used source research and no model inference.
field_principles.ledger_append_rows: Append rows isolate genuinely new verified facts from repeated ledger content.
field_principles.model_specs: An explicit empty invocation receipt prevents cited model names from implying that inference ran.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preflight rows prove the roadmap, ledger, policy, and dated plan existed before research.
field_principles.query_rows: One terminal row per query preserves no-update and access-failure outcomes.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes deterministic row ordering reproducible.
field_principles.rate_limit_rows: Rate-limit rows keep missing responses from becoming false no-update claims.
field_principles.rejected_finding_rows: Rejected rows retain exclusions and stop weak evidence from disappearing.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The payload hash detects any later change to the research receipt.
field_principles.rows: A combined row ledger lets a checker inspect evidence without trusting summaries.
field_principles.run_date: The date separates this execution-time check from the earlier planning sweep.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema lets later validators detect a changed artifact contract.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the result to the exact local sources that defined V606.
field_principles.source_family_rows: Family summaries prove that every required source surface terminated.
field_principles.status: A terminal status distinguishes a complete source pass from a blocked preflight.
field_principles.v606_sota_ingestion_complete_score: The score becomes one only when every required source and method has a terminal row.
field_principles.v607_candidate_rows: Future ideas stay advisory and cannot silently rewrite locked V606 work.
field_principles.verdict_class: The class separates an advisory update from a null or blocked research outcome.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that source review is not an executable correctness oracle.
